source.name: NASA TESS SPOC light curves (PDCSAP) from MAST, via lightkurve

processing: Stitched, NaNs removed, 5-sigma outliers removed, flattened with a 1001-cadence window (lightkurve), as in candidate_scan.py.

binning.method: median of the flattened flux in fixed 10-minute bins of BTJD time; empty bins dropped

periodogram.method: BLS power on the unbinned flattened flux, 12000 periods from 0.5 to 30.0 days, kept as the peak of each of 1500 equal chunks
